name: AXM Protocol Version Observatory
actions: inventory exact declared protocol tokens by role
group only slash-versioned AXM protocol families
surface multiple declared versions and mixed unparsed family tokens
summary: Read-only protocol version surface that groups exact AXM slash-version declarations without treating multiple versions as incompatibility or inventing migrations.
notes: This observatory does not validate protocols, infer compatibility, choose a preferred version, rewrite declarations, generate adapters or migrations, install modules, or change CANON.
